source_summary: Ink-on-paper Chinese landscape with upper inscription excluded; reusable motifs are drawn from the distant river-and-mountain band and the lower bamboo grove with scholars and foreground bank.

motifs.name: distant_left_peak_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the pale triangular mountain mass at the far left horizon with its sloping shoreline and adjoining low ridge strokes.
must_preserve: dry, broken ink contour lines on the peak
soft grey wash forming the triangular slope
small dark vegetation or rock ticks along the ridge
thin horizontal shoreline strokes at the base
faint mist-softened edges

motifs.name: midriver_low_islets
motifs.description: Isolate the low distant islets and waterline strokes across the middle horizon, including the small central peaked islet and scattered flat sandbar marks.
motifs.role: distant river islets and water surface
must_preserve: very thin horizontal water strokes
small dark angular islet peaks near center
broken dry-brush sandbar lines
wide blank mist gaps between strokes
subtle grey wash variations

motifs.name: central_tall_bamboo_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the main vertical bamboo grove in the lower center-right, including the tallest pale stalk, clustered leaves, and dark lower shoots.
must_preserve: long pale vertical bamboo trunks
fine joint markings and narrow nodes
delicate clustered leaf sprays around the upper stalks
darker ink leaves on the right cluster
dense base grasses and black shoot accents
dry-brush texture on the central trunks

motifs.name: right_slender_bamboo_spray
motifs.description: Isolate the airy bamboo and reed sprays on the far right side, with thin arcing stems and sparse leaf clusters.
must_preserve: arching hairline bamboo stems
tiny paired leaf marks
open spacing and pale ink gaps
small dark grass strokes at the base
right-leaning rhythm of the sprays

motifs.name: left_bending_bamboo_thicket
motifs.description: Isolate the left foreground thicket of bending bamboo, including the sweeping curved stems rising from the lower-left ground.
must_preserve: long bowed bamboo canes
fine stippled leaf clusters
dark basal shoots
light grey wash at the ground edge
asymmetrical leftward leaning composition

motifs.name: middle_wispy_bamboo_screen
motifs.description: Isolate the faint middle-left bamboo screen behind the figures, made of pale stems and small loose leaf marks.
must_preserve: very light ink stems
scattered small leaf flicks
transparent dry-brush quality
misty spacing between bamboo clusters
soft vertical rhythm

motifs.name: two_scholars_on_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the two small standing scholar figures on the lower-left bank, including their robes, heads, and the object or staff held by the left figure.
must_preserve: thin contour linework of the robes
small dark hair or hat marks
gesture of the left figure holding a slender object
upright stance of the right figure
minimal ground strokes directly beneath their feet

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_bank_strokes
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground bank with flat rocks, broken ground lines, dark grass shoots, and pale wash, excluding seals and inscription areas.
must_preserve: flat angular rock outlines
broken dry-brush ground texture
short black grass and shoot accents
soft grey wash suggesting damp earth
scattered diagonal ink ticks

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
